title: BHTSP Contract Administration Panel - Aug 26
description:
The Department of Transport and Main Roads (TMR) is seeking applications for new applicants to join the BHTSP Contract Administration Panel.

This application process is only for new applicants wishing to join the BHTSP Contract Administration Panel (existing BHTSP Contract Administration Panel Members are not permitted to apply for this process).

The Department of Transport and Main Roads (TMR) is delivering the Bruce Highway Targeted Safety Program (BHTSP). The Bruce Highway is a vital 1,673 kilometre north-south corridor in Queensland, connecting Brisbane to Cairns. In January 2025, the Australian and Queensland governments announced a joint funding commitment of $9 billion towards the BHTSP to enhance safety and uplift deficient sections of the highway to achieve a three-star rating.

The BHTSP focuses on sections of the Bruce Highway between Gympie and Cairns with a high safety risk.

title: Cooktown Multi-Purpose Health Service (MPHS) Redevelopment – Enabling Works - Civil Contractor
description:
The State of Queensland through Queensland Health (the Principal), invites you to submit a Tender for the provision of a suitably qualified civil contractor to construct the Enabling Works for the Cooktown MPHS Redevelopment in accordance with the Invitation documents.

The Queensland Government is investing $200 million to redevelop the Cooktown Multipurpose Health Service (CMPHS), improving access to care for Cooktown and surrounding communities.

Health Infrastructure Queensland in partnership with Torres and Cape Hospital and Health Service are responsible for delivery of the project as part of the Hospital Rescue Plan. The project will deliver a range of essential healthcare facilities and services to meet the needs of the community and reduce the need for patients to travel outside the region.

The scope of this request is for an enabling works package the Project team have identified to mitigate risks to the main construction which is planned in 2027.

title: TEN/2893 Waste Facilities Maintenance
description:
